subject: Request: Exec authorization for >20% Hosted API usage concession (HealthGrid pilot)
messages:
From: Sara Ellis <sara@healthgrid.io>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-10T09:12:00Z
Subject: Quick question about pilot pricing and discounts

Hi Ava,

Thanks again for the demo this morning — the hosted inference latency and cost numbers looked promising. Our execs want to run a 6-month pilot (ingest + generation) across two teams and we have a constrained budget for Q3.

Can Redwood offer a one-time pilot concession on Hosted API usage — we're looking for ~25% off list for the pilot period in exchange for a published case study and a 12-month follow-on commit if the pilot meets latency/cost goals. If you need a procurement doc we can share a short SOW.

Best,
Sara
Sara Ellis
Head of AI Integrations, HealthGrid
Attachments: HealthGrid_SOW_outline.pdf (stub)

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Sara Ellis <sara@healthgrid.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-10T13:04:00Z
Subject: Re: Quick question about pilot pricing and discounts

Sara — appreciate the clear ask and the case study incentive.

Short answer: we can be flexible but anything >20% requires senior approval. I've attached a one-page forecast you promised and a draft SOW to help with evaluation. Can you confirm expected monthly token volume for the pilot and the target SLA? That will help speed the approval flow.

I'll loop in Deal Desk and Ben for exec escalation if they confirm target volumes.

Cheers,
Ava Chen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: HealthGrid_Usage_Forecast_Q3-Q4.xlsx (stub); SOW_HealthGrid_v1.pdf (stub)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-12T10:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: Exec authorization for >20% Hosted API usage concession (HealthGrid pilot)

Thanks for the heads-up — reviewed the forecast. Summary:
- Pilot: 6 months, expected 1.5B tokens total (~250M tokens/month).
- Proposed commercial ask: 25% off list for pilot (credits applied to monthly usage).
- Commitment ask (if pilot passes): 12-month minimum at standard volume-based tiers.

Recommendation: approve up to 15% commercial concession at the AE level + $25k pilot credit on top for marketing/case study. Anything above 20% needs VP/Finance ok due to unit economics risk (hosted unit cost vs list).

If Sales leadership wants to press for 25%, please provide: customer logo value, specific timing of public case study, and a clear acceptance metric (latency and cost targets).

- Karthik
Deal Desk, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-13T15:08:00Z
Subject: Escalation: HealthGrid pilot — request for >20% concession (25%)

Marcus — quick ask for finance/senior clearance. HealthGrid (mid-market health SaaS) is asking for a 25% off Hosted API usage rate for a 6-month pilot in exchange for a published case study and a 12-month follow-on commit if metrics are met. Key facts below:
- Forecasted pilot volume: ~250M tokens/month (1.5B tokens total).
- ARR upside: conservative model shows ~$420k ARR if commit converts at tiered pricing.
- Case study: HealthGrid will agree to a co-branded case study and joint press if pilot meets latency and cost SLAs by month 3.
- Risks: 25% materially reduces unit margin vs expected hosted cost; sets pricing precedent for similar mid-market deals if we don't document guardrails.

Attachments: forecast + SOW included. Karthik recommends flat 15% + $25k marketing credit; I'm leaning to offer a conditional 25% concession but require: (1) signed SOW with 12-month follow-on minimum, (2) auto-fallback to standard list rates if monthly token >320M, (3) explicit case study timing and approvals.

Can you confirm finance is comfortable with a one-time 25% pilot concession under those conditions? If yes, I'll inform HealthGrid and draft the conditional approval language.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Head of Revenue Operations

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-14T16:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Escalation: HealthGrid pilot — request for >20% concession (25%)

Ben / team — reviewed economics with Finance. Conditional approval granted for a 25% off Hosted API usage concession for the 6-month pilot, subject to all of the following being executed prior to start:
1) Signed SOW that includes a 12-month minimum commitment that takes effect immediately following the pilot OR a minimum conversion payment equal to 6 months at the contracted post-pilot rate.
2) A clearly defined case study plan with deadlines (draft by month 4, final publish by month 7) and approvals — legal to sign-off on co-branding language.
3) A usage cap clause: if any month exceeds 320M tokens, list rates apply for the remainder of that month and finance reviews overage reconciliation.
4) Redwood holds sole right to redact any customer data in published materials; HealthGrid must approve non-sensitive excerpts.

If those conditions are met, Marketing and Finance will support the pilot and I approve the 25% concession as a one-time, non-precedent-setting exception. Ben, please draft the conditional approval memo and I will sign.

-Marcus Lin
VP Finance, Redwood Inference
